name: Karen Hoover
bio: Clinical Associate Professor of Occupational Therapy at Clarkson, joining in 2023 after a decade at Seton Hall University, where she directed clinical education. An occupational therapist for nearly 30 years and a pediatric specialist, she previously owned a private pediatric outpatient practice and was co-investigator on the federal $1.2M Project Write to Learn personnel-preparation grant training OTs and speech-language pathologists.
